items.headline: Saudi ne Hodeida bandargah par hamla kiya
items.detail: Saudi-led gathbandhan ne Houthi ke kabze wale Hodeida port par hamla kiya aur Saada-Amran me lakshya dhwast kiye; Houthi ne Saudi bandargahon par badle ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Shanghai chief Chen Jining jaanch ke ghere me
items.detail: Cheen ki bhrashtachar-rodhi agency ne Politburo sadasya aur Shanghai party chief Chen Jining par 'gambhir anushasan ullanghan' ki jaanch shuru ki; 2025 se chauthe Politburo sadasya par jaanch hai.
items.exam_angle: Cheen rajneeti, Xi ki bhrashtachar-rodhi muheem — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU ka Russia par 22nd sanctions package
items.detail: European Commission ne Russia par 22nd sanctions package prastav kiya — 60 bank SWIFT se bahar, 70 se zyada shadow fleet jahaz, aur EU me Russia ke jhande tale khel par pratibandh.
items.exam_angle: EU-Russia pratibandh, SWIFT, shadow fleet — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hanoi restaurant dhamaka, 6 mare
items.detail: Hanoi ke Dong Da jile me hotpot restaurant me gas dhamake se 6 log mare aur 10 ghayal hue; aas-paas ki lagbhag 10 imaraton ko nuksan pahuncha.

items.headline: Riyadh tower par dobara hamla, 11 ghayal
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Houthi drone ne Riyadh ke King Abdullah Financial District ki PIF Tower par dobara hamla kiya; 11 log ghayal hue, jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain.
items.exam_angle: Houthi hamle, Saudi-Yemen sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ki sabse badi scam karvai
items.detail: America ke Nyay Vibhag ne duniya bhar me 400 se zyada mamlo me 800 se zyada aaropiyon par karvai ki; FBI ke Operation Blackout me 4 mahadweepon par 29 scam compound dhwast kiye gaye.
items.exam_angle: Cyber dhokhadhadi, Operation Blackout — UPSC S&T

items.headline: Gaza me doosra Hamas adhikari mara gaya
items.detail: Budhvaar subah Gaza City me Israeli hamle me Hamas ke suraksha adhikari Mohammad Abuelouf, unki patni aur 2 bachche mare gaye; 24 ghante me doosre bade Hamas adhikari ki maut hai.
items.exam_angle: Gaza sangharsh, yuddh-viram — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ka drone Poland ki seema me ghusa
items.detail: 23 November ki raat Russia ka nigrani drone Poland ke hawai-kshetra me ghus gaya; Poland ne ise jaanboojh kar uksav kaha, lekin nagrikon ko khatra dekh kar use giraya nahi.
items.exam_angle: NATO-Russia tanaav, Poland — UPSC IR

items.headline: Samara ki 2 refinery par drone hamla
items.detail: Raat ke drone hamle me Rosneft ki Syzran aur Kuibyshev refinery me aag lag gayi; governor ne 145 drone giraye jaane aur 1 vyakti ki maut ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Fort Hood hamlaawar ki execution rokne ki arzi
items.detail: 2009 Fort Hood hamle ke doshi Nidal Hasan ne 3 December ko firing squad se hone wali execution par rok ke liye Kansas court me arzi di; sunvai aaj hogi.

items.headline: Odesa hamle me 2 mare, ladka bhi
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Odesa me ek 17 saal ke ladke samet 2 log mare gaye, 3 ghayal; Kyiv me drone ke malbe se building me aag lagi, 2 ghayal.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bangladesh me garment vetan 36% badha
items.detail: Vetan board ne nyuntam vetan 12,500 se badhakar 17,000 taka kiya; mazdoor 30,000 taka mang rahe the, 1 December se lagu hoga.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh garment udyog, shramik vetan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Colombia me car bomb, 23 ghayal
items.detail: Villavicencio me sarkari karyalaya ke bahar car bomb phata, 23 log ghayal; rashtrapati ne FARC-EMC vidrohi gut ko zimmedaar thahraya.
items.exam_angle: Colombia hinsa, FARC shanti samjhota — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ko pehla gathbandhan saathi mila
items.detail: Israel me Eisenkot ki Yashar party ne Lieberman ki party se pehla gathbandhan samjhota kiya; 6 December tak sarkar banane ki samay-seema hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel rajneeti, Netanyahu — UPSC IR

items.headline: America sainik ne Cheen ko raaz beche
items.detail: America ke sena sargent Jian Zhao ne Cheen se jude kharidaron ko HIMARS aur sainya jankari bechne ka aarop mana; 10 saal tak ki saza ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Cheen jasusi, HIMARS — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Putin ne badle ki dhamki di
items.detail: Putin ne kaha Ukraine ne Trump ki appeal ke bawjood refineries par hamle jaari rakhe; badla tay hai, aur hamlo se refinery processing 45% ghata hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Uttar Korea ki Swiss karyalaya band karne ki dhamki
items.detail: Kim Yo Jong ne kaha Songdowon shivir par Swiss pratibandh ke baad Pyongyang me Swiss karyalaya band karne par vichaar hoga.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea-Russia sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia hamle me 2 mare, 40 ghayal
items.detail: Russia ke subah ke hamle me ek ghar tabah hua aur paanch manzila building ko nuksan pahuncha; chaar bachche bhi ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cartagena supermarket me bandhak sankat
items.detail: Colombia ke Cartagena me sashastr hamlaavaron ne Exito supermarket me lagbhag 30 logon ko bandhak banaya; 10 ko riha kar diya gaya, police aur sena ne dukaan ko gher rakha hai.

items.headline: Houthi Aden ke 60 km paas pahunche
items.detail: Houthi ladake Yemen ki asthayi rajdhani Aden se lagbhag 60 km door pahunch gaye; sarkari sena ne raksha rekha banayi aur kaha Aden surakshit rahega.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih-yuddh, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Estonia rail border band karne par vichaar
items.detail: Pradhan Mantri Kristen Michal ne kaha Estonia Narva rail crossing band karne par vichaar kar raha hai; 1 December se sadak seema band ho rahi hai, GRU tod-fod koshish ke baad.
items.exam_angle: NATO-Russia tanaav, Baltic suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ki Houthi hamle se chetavni
items.detail: America ke Videsh Vibhag ne Madhya Poorv me apne nagrikon ko Houthi hamlo aur Iran ke khatre ko dekhte hue satark rehne ko kaha; udaan radd aur hawai-kshetra band hone ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav, Houthi hamle — West Asia

items.headline: Shenzhou-24 uda, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri
items.detail: Cheen ke Shenzhou-24 ne Jiuquan se udaan bhari; Pakistan ke Zeeshan Ali Tiangong station par jaane wale pehle videshi antariksh-yatri bane, ek hafte ke mission par.
items.exam_angle: Tiangong station, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri — UPSC S&T

items.headline: Mississippi ke paas viman gira, 6 lapata
items.detail: New Orleans se Fort Myers ja raha Cessna viman Horn Island ke paas samudra me gira; 4 vayask aur 2 bachche sawaar the, Coast Guard talaash me juta hai.
